At (1,4), G=[1-(1-u)^6]/(6u) with removable G(0)=1; five simple zeros at u_j=1-e^{2πij/6}, only two of modulus1 (e±iπ/3), rest |u|=√3 or 2, none interior. Uniform closed-disk parameter continuity, nonzero near u=1 and Rouché/analytic IFT keep exactly the two conjugate simple nearby roots as the only candidates entering the disk. At u0=e^{iπ/3}, G_u=1, G_s=-119/360+(7√3/45)i and G_α=π(√3+i)/36, yielding ∂s log|u+|=-49/720, ∂α log|u+|=-π√3/36. The real IFT produces unique transverse analytic boundary α_c(1)=4 with derivative -49√3/(60π); below/equal no scalar disk zeros, above exactly two simple zeros. This is a local theorem only.
